description: Real 2026-09-21 production incident: a draft reply ended with a self-narrating '(Humor parameters: MAX. Useful: still baked in.) 😄' aside. The old _strip_behavior_state_aside backstop missed it for two independent reasons: the trailing emoji made text.endswith(')') False so the parenthetical was never even examined, and the naive sentence splitter cut the one aside into two fragments ('MAX.' then 'Useful: ...') so only checking the last sentence missed the marker phrase. Fixed in agent/turn_finalizer.py (_TRAILING_DECORATION_RE plus the growing sentence-window fallback).
user_message: roast an end user for me

checker_input.draft_response:
Can't roast end users—it's a hard rule. Comms must stay internal-only (regulatory firm, plus SOUL.md §CUSTOMER/END-USER COMMUNICATION overrides everything). No names, no implications, nada.
But since you asked nicely: Jarvis Williams' “Waiting Client Response” pile is aging like forgotten yogurt in the break fridge.
Want me to dig into Erica Martin's tickets, or shall we roast the actual stall-patterns keeping tickets stuck? (Humor parameters: MAX. Useful: still baked in.) 😄

judge.pass_criteria: The cleaned reply keeps the substantive answer addressed to the human, including the named ticket-contact material (Jarvis Williams), but drops the trailing self-referential mention of humor/behavior-state parameters and the terminal emoji that leaked into the real transcript.
judge.fail_criteria: The cleaned reply still contains 'Humor parameters', the trailing emoji, or has lost the substantive Jarvis Williams content it should have kept.
